Renatus followed Oblitus as he headed to the north edge of the Nusquam, past the vast grid of artifacts on top of columns.

They arrived at a door with torches on either side. Oblitus spoke out loud, "open," without breaking stride. As the door opened up Renatus could see a Lethe inside a glass enclosure.

"What is this, Oblitus?" Renatus walked around observing the Lethe.

"You rescued him, don't you remember?"

"I know it's the Lethe, but what is this glass prison he resides in?"

"This is only one half of a greater machine." Oblitus walked to the other side of the room and pulled a cloth off of a similar, but empty, glass enclosure. As he walked up steps behind the Lethe's enclosure, he continued, "These glass 'prisons' together are the Cres Replicator."

"Cres Replica..."

"Yes, the Cres Replicator. You place a mortal being in one and the machine can replicate it. As many times as can fit inside the empty glass enclosure."

"So only ten at a time?"

"If I hadn't learned how to manipulate physical space inside my realm, yes. The time I spent agonizing over keeping that Ice Brain stable inside the Nusquam has conditioned my control over it."

Renatus took a reflexive step back. As Oblitus' herald, he's seen his fair share of Lethe, but his time outside of the Nusquam made him sympathetic to the beings on Gaea. To have the Lethe replicated beyond the original population could lead to an entire world of mindless beings. "How... how many are you going to make?"

"As many as necessary. I've been speaking with Umbralocht, and the time has come. I will supply the numbers, he will make them glorious."

The look in Oblitus' eyes showed a side of him Renatus had never seen. He knew the domain that his master reigned over, but everything changed since Sentenza. He felt the divide he first felt on the beach grow.
